description: This file is a Spring MVC controller named MiniCartController that manages shopping cart interactions for a web shop, including displaying and removing items from the mini shopping cart.

classes.name: MiniCartController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling mini shopping cart operations such as displaying and removing items.

methods.name: displayMiniCart
methods.description: Handles requests to display the mini shopping cart data based on the cart code, setting session attributes accordingly.

methods.name: removeShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles requests to remove an item from the shopping cart and updates the session and cart state.
